scripts.check: pnpm run check:engine && pnpm run check:ui && pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:streamdock
scripts.check:engine: cd engine && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy --strict src && uv run pytest
scripts.check:ui: pnpm --filter ui lint && pnpm --filter ui typecheck && pnpm --filter ui test
scripts.check:rust: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.check:streamdock: cd streamdock && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.smoke: uv run --project engine python scripts/smoke-sidecar.py src-tauri/binaries/engine-*
scripts.version:check: uv run --project engine python scripts/version.py check
scripts.version:bump: uv run --project engine python scripts/version.py bump
